mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 74 degrees at Verona City Hall. The moon is in its third quarter phase, and tonight the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Verona Parks Department reminds residents that they manage the local cemetery and are currently accepting applications for plots. Also, the city offers a rebate program for residents who install rain barrels on their property to help manage stormwater.

There is a lot happening this week in Verona. Today, enjoy the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia.

In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a 20-year-old woman for possession of T H C and drug paraphernalia, while the driver was cited for operating without a valid license.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is open until 10 PM, so stop by soon for a treat. Also, please note that Kona Ice has no scheduled stops in Verona for today.
